observations.finding: Each selected archive has one servant_skill and no deck; neither owner/card is in the current production executable pack.
observations.existingSupport: authoringServantFiles -> convertAuthoringServant -> startingDeckFromAuthoring -> compileExecutableCardPack -> MatchSession buildInitialState
observations.guard: Product loader and executable compiler independently require exactly three servant skills and twelve deck cards.
observations.cardOnlyPath: No existing servant rules-only archive/channel found. servantCardFiles is presentation input, not executable rules.archives and not owner instantiation. Rules-only exemptions cover master support/master rules/events, not servants.
observations.minimumDelta: Complete canonically sourced playable owner content with source assets, or obtain separately reviewed admission design. Do not bypass current invariants, synthesize missing skills/decks, borrow a different owner, or manually patch generated files.

observations.finding: Both cards encode continuous_formula + forced_trigger, no residual kind or lifecycle. Session round cleanup retains attack_area cards only if a residual-kind ability survives its cleanup exclusion.
observations.rule: Final Rules 11.3/11.5: active residual remains until closed and participates each round without repeat payment.
observations.reuse: Existing residual marker, shared playBatch, attack_area active state and cleanup machinery can be reused as components.
observations.minimumDelta: Map the actual printed reward ability to an explicit active-source residual contract, not a dummy residual ability. Its exact compiler/runtime ownership must be reviewed together with reward routing.

observations.finding: isDeploymentResourceRewardCandidate requires forced_trigger; exact validator rejects requiresSourceState and any lifecycle. Current reward has no active-source requirement. Changing kind to residual leaves the typed candidate and allows generic/legacy execution; adding active/lifecycle alone makes the current forced-trigger exact shape reject.
observations.currentEligibility: Generic canActivate only validates active source when activation.requiresSourceState explicitly says active. A residual kind alone does not enforce active provenance.
observations.minimumDelta: Add one identity-free residual deployment-reward ownership/validator boundary using accepted Card Zone active-source policy, retaining the old forced-trigger contract unchanged and reusing typed mana/VP effects. Malformed candidate must not escape to legacy.

observations.finding: MatchSession.deploy emits after_player_deployed_to_battlefield only inside tags.includes(battlefield). Default magic_workshop tags are support_location, and legalDeploymentActions includes it. Real workshop deployment does not emit the currently authored reward trigger.
observations.inputPacketCorrection: PREPARE describes the existing event/component chain but does not establish that the real workshop producer executes it.
observations.testBoundary: FM05 and FB2-02 tests directly inject after_player_deployed_to_battlefield with magic_workshop; not real deployment evidence.
observations.minimumDelta: Freeze a location-deployment occurrence contract covering legal support-location deployment while preserving existing battlefield-trigger meaning and movement != deployment. Decide exact event encoding with RB before implementation; do not silently broaden every battlefield consumer.

observations.finding: startRound resets locations and draws hands without replaying retained attacks. Combat authoredAttacks uses controller, attack_area and active cardState without requiring current playedRound, then calculateCardPower reads current round. Shared playBatch pays printed cost on first play only.
observations.cost: Printed cost 0; skill-zone play still requires at least 8 mana under Final Rules 9.4 and the existing playRequirements. Retention does not mean paying 8 mana or paying cost each round.
observations.gap: Without canonical residual mapping the card is discarded and deactivated at cleanup. Production retention, next-round reward and battle result remain NOT_VERIFIED.

requiredNegativeMatrix: Both consumers: exact printed text and full source provenance survive compile
First face-up skill play with >=8 mana, printed cost 0; <8 rejects; face-down skill rejects
Before activation, after close, face-down, missing/corrupt cardState, wrong controller or source zone: no reward
Real deployment to workshop triggers only controller source; ordinary movement, wrong location/player and disallowed deployment do not
Activate in action does not retroactively reward earlier advance deployment; same-round future eligible occurrence only if legally available
Cleanup keeps live residual, next-round formula recomputes and attack participates without re-use/re-payment; closed source does not revive
Same event replay no duplicate reward; mana cap applies; second resource failure rolls back cards/resources/events/revision for declared transaction
Wrong kind/trigger/source policy/extra fields and malformed effect/binding rejected by compiler/runtime ownership; no legacy success
Production pack/session/reconnect restore of retained active source; synthetic owner/card assignment never counts as admission proof
